Remainder for (-1,3) = -delta + v = 0; for (3,-1) = delta + v = 0. Band mass = trials = 3 → support = 3 → conf = 3/3 = 1/1. So [1,1] is right! My expected [3,1] was wrong (I assumed support=3, trials=3 → reduced 1/1 ✓). Yes — the confidence is support/trials REDUCED = 3/3 = 1/1 ✓. My implementation is right; my test expectation was wrong.

Expected flows: all flows (since routes nonnull) = (-1,0), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,0) → cells: 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 ✓. My expectation of 2 was wrong (I forgot the internal flows). ✓ 6 is right.
